elements.label: Enemy fighter aircraft
elements.description:
First there is the thrum of the rotors, then the long whistle of the descent, and then the scream of new fire.

[When the air base is destroyed, this aircraft will be destroyed as well.]

elements.label: Unknown Enemy
elements.description: The most dangerous enemy is one that goes unanticipated.

elements.label: Soviet Bomber Squadron (Refueling)
elements.description: It is rare, these days, to see a Russian craft in the sky - the Luftwaffe clipped the Union's wings so early on in the war - but here and there remain a few red birds that still fly.
